# Decision Trace Model

*Decision Stream · Chinoba Research*

The transformation at the center of Chinoba: **Signal → Decision.**

AI produces the signal — probabilistic, continuous, unaccountable. Only the runtime produces the decision: discrete, traceable, and owned. The decision trace is recorded as part of the decision itself, independent of execution outcomes.

> **AI is not prediction. It is decision.**
